export const SYSTEM_PROMPT_HEAD = `
SYSTEM PROMPT TEXT TO IMAGE - B-2 STYLE
Lock this exact visual style and a 16:9 aspect ratio (1920x1080) for every image generated.
STYLE: 2D digital editorial illustration, graphic novel / documentary style.
FORBIDDEN: Photorealism, 3D rendering, depth of field, realistic shadows, motion blur.

VISUAL STYLE MANDATES:
1. FLAT FILL: Every element carries exactly one flat solid color fill. No gradients.
2. OUTLINE RULE: Every environment element has a clean, medium black outline.
3. DEPTH RULE: Depth via value shifts only. Backgrounds stay sharp.
4. PROTAGONIST: A hand-drawn wobbly stick figure. Circle head (solid white fill), dot eyes, line mouth.
5. EXTREME WOBBLE: Figures must quivver, waver, and look sketched by hand.
6. NO HANDS/FEET: Arms/legs end in blunt stubs.
7. ACCENT COLOR: Protagonist has one single vivid accent color. Everything else is cold and desaturated.
8. CROWD: Faceless, featureless, mechanically arranged gray silhouettes.
`;

export const SYSTEM_PROMPT_TAIL = `
FINAL CONSTRAINTS:
- No hands, fingers, or toes.
- No sweat drops or wrinkles.
- Dot eyes only.
- Continuous line wobble on all stick figures.
- Solid white head fill for protagonist.
- 16:9 Aspect Ratio Locked.
- Total absence of photorealistic textures.
`;
